Check it out here: robots.phospho.ai . What is personal grounding for LLMs, and why is it important? Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and other AI search engines are becoming more popular by the day – with each one seeming more advanced in its ability to understand and respond to human queries. These models do have their challenges when used in the real world, though, especially in business contexts, or in very niche industries. LLMs need “grounding” because while they are trained to have a broad understanding of language and logic, they are still reasoning engines, meaning they lack contextual and domain-specific understanding. Answers aren’t always precise or correct, and sometimes they just aren’t contextually relevant, leading to frustration, inaccurate data and time lost for users. Grounding helps LLMs to better understand and connect with users in the real world. The process of grounding also helps to prevent hallucinations – which is where wrong data is presented confidently and convincingly even though it’s inaccurate. Grounding an LLM will help the model to understand the meaning and context behind words and better navigate the nuances of human language to better help users in the real world. However, there is a difference between “general grounding” and “personal grounding”. In this article, we’ll explore the two types of grounding processes for LLMs and present Phospho, our text analytics platform, that can help you ground your AI model. How Does General Grounding Work? Grounding is the process of anchoring or linking language model outputs to reliable and accurate information. The process is important as it makes sure LLMs like search engines provide factual, relevant and appropriate information. This is essential in every case, but you can see how it might be particularly crucial in professional or high stakes cases, such as journalism, data science or healthcare. Standard LLMs are fairly limited, as any casual ChatGPT user will tell you. They rely completely on trained knowledge and lack real-time contextual updates, so information might be wrong, out of date or not relevant to the user’s query. Ungrounded LMMs are also more prone to errors and hallucinations, throwing up wrong information or misunderstanding the question. The focus of grounding is to tailor model responses to your users, making sure they only receive the most accurate and relevant information. Grounding improves LLM performance in the following ways: Makes Responses More Relevant and Accurate The process of grounding makes responses more accurate because the LLM taps into external data sources – such as business documents or databases – to find the best answers to user questions. No More Hallucinations or Errors By connecting the model to real-time data, grounding reduces the risk of hallucinations and incorrect responses, resulting in more accurate responses. Supports RAG Grounded LLM models often use Retrieval-Automated Generation (RAG) when they pull information from external documents and databases. This process makes responses much more reliable as they are based on verified and up-to-date information from reputable, approved sources. Personalized User Experiences It’s clear from the benefits we’ve already described that grounding allows LLMs to deliver much more personalized user experiences. Responses will not only be more accurate but they’ll also be closer aligned to users’ past interactions and preferences, resulting in much more conversational, user-friendly search. General and Personal Grounding for Product Optimization You might be wondering, what is personal grounding for LLMs and when is it used? Personal grounding refers to the process of customizing an LLM response based on specific user or organizational data. The main difference is that personal grounding incorporates user-specific contexts and data, while general grounding relies on publicly available, more general information. When Is Grounding Used for LLMs? All LLMs should be grounded to some extent, but personal grounding may be required in niche industries or specific business contexts. For example, in industries like finance and healthcare where data precision is crucial, LLMs should be grounded using department or business data documents and relevant databases to make sure results are relevant and accurate. Similarly, an LLM that’s used for a customer support chatbot can be grounded using company FAQ documents and data so it delivers specific answers to user questions, rather than more generalized information that may not be helpful. An educational app may also use a personal grounding system to generate answers based on the curriculum or a particular set of textbooks, while tech companies could train their LLMs according to product information or technical documentation. Although personal grounding is important, it does come with some inherent challenges. For one, it can be difficult and time-consuming to integrate real-time, highly specific data into LLMs, but there are also concerns about data privacy, especially when it comes to sensitive information, such as healthcare records. Text Analytics, Grounding and LLMs: What’s the Connection? Text analytics is relevant to grounding and personal grounding in a few different ways. The term refers to the process of extracting data insights and structured information from an unstructured text source. Text analytics allows businesses to analyze user interactions and common issues and use this feedback to update and improve their LLM. It’s an important function for iterative training, as it helps feed models with up-to-date information, making responses more accurate and timely. LLMS need to be able to identify edge cases and anomalies so they can quickly improve, which text analytics can help with. Companies can also define their own metrics and KPIs to better monitor user satisfaction and work on model improvements. title: Agricultural Sources of Particulate Matter
summary: Context Corner Edition 9
body_text: Radical Transparency Agricultural Sources of Particulate Matter Context Corner Edition 9 November 8, 2024 By Carrie Crumpton, CNX Vice President of Environmental Strategy Through our Radical Transparency program , we not only monitor and disclose raw data in real time to state regulators and the public, but we also leverage the program as an opportunity to investigate when we see an anomaly in the data. Each operational location has its own unique characteristics, and we view any data anomaly as an opportunity to study, learn, improve, and customize our operating practices to the benefit of each local community. In other words, the program has provided an ancillary benefit beyond simply sharing data and providing the public with first-of-its kind transparency from the natural gas industry; it’s an opportunity for our industry to learn, adapt, and enhance operations in real time. ​ In that vein, we occasionally see readings of PM2.5 (particulate matter measuring 2.5 micrometers in diameter) that are higher than expected for the activity (or lack of activity) that is occurring on a pad location. As you’ll recall from previous Context Corner editions , PM2.5 sources can be emissions from combustion of gasoline, oil, diesel fuel, wood, or other biomass; or dusts and dirt from unsealed roads, construction, landfill, and agriculture. Some pollens and molds can also contribute to particulate matter that can register on certain devices that record PM2.5. When we are alerted to these ‘higher than expected’ readings, our team responds to review the conditions on location to ensure our process and equipment are working as designed. Our team often observes adjacent activity that could be contributing to the readings we are recording. As we consider possible contributing factors for these unexpected readings, one thing to remember is that well pads are not large industrial complexes that are isolated from other typical activities in the region. Well pads in Appalachia are sited alongside other activities such as coal mining operations and, more often, near agricultural activity, which is prominent within our operating footprint. USDA’s 2023 State Agricultural Overview reports there are over 49,000 Farm Operations totaling more than 7,100,000 acres with agricultural operations in Pennsylvania. CNX well pads are alongside and often surrounded by some of these agricultural activities. Activities occurring on these working farms can contribute to the air quality readings we see at our pad locations. The monitors we utilize do not differentiate from where the PM2.5 originates. Exhaust, dust, smoke, and pollen from these agricultural activities are detected and recorded as well. ​ CNX recognizes that unique air quality challenges exist in agriculture. From application of pesticides and fertilizers, plowing and tilling, etc., to the management of livestock waste and burning of crop residues, agricultural practices release contaminants including volatile organic compounds and particulate matter, among others. CNX is taking steps to help better understand the region's PM2.5 by looking for contributions from well pad/development activity and hope that others can utilize the robust dataset to explore other possible sources of PM2.5. We view this as an opportunity for innovation and transformation. CNX believes that the data we record and provide can help advance air quality across the region and could innovate opportunities outside of the sphere of natural gas, like opportunities to move forward sustainable agricultural practices such as conservation tillage, precision farming, or integrated pest management. CNX appreciates the mutually beneficial opportunity to develop natural gas alongside agriculture in Appalachia and is proud to contribute to the direct economic benefit for the agricultural community. These synchronous activities have cemented the opportunity for multi-generational family farms to continue for generations to come by providing supplemental income to families and improving opportunities for investments in new technology and equipment. These investments and the efficiencies that are gained preserve the Appalachian region’s farming culture and help preserve the competitive viability of the family farm in Appalachia. Tangible data leads to innovative, impactful solutions that benefit everyone in the (local) region. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ Context Corner Edition 5 – Data is in! What is it saying? title: How to Run for Senate
summary: Our guide on how to run for Senate as a first time candidate will show you how political campaigns work and how you can get started.
body_text: Interested in helping the United States move toward more progressive policies on healthcare, child care, police brutality, criminal justice reform, education costs, student debt, and more? Thinking about running for office for the first time? ‍ If you’re a first-time candidate looking to run for a Senate seat in the U.S. Congress, we have a guide for you! Here, we’ll focus on running for Senate (if the House is a better fit, check out our guide on how to run for the House of Representatives ). In this article on running to be Senator, we’ll touch on the following topics: The basics on how to run a Senate race What research is essential to prepare for a Senate campaign How to set up a successful political campaign We’ll also give you a ton of resources for finding even more information that will help you get started on a successful Senate campaign. How to Run for Senate How you set up a political campaign depends on the office for which you’re running. This step-by-step guide thus aims to help you learn how to run specifically for a U.S. Senate seat. First, let’s look at a few basic questions about the office. How many Senators are in the U.S. Senate? The Senate has 100 Senators. Each of the 50 U.S. states elects 2 Senators to Congress. How long is a Senate term? Senate terms last for 6 years. Senate elections are spread out so that one-third of Senate seats are up for reelection every even-numbered year. To illustrate, 33 Senate seats are up for regular election in 2026 : 13 currently held by Democrats and 20 by Republicans, plus special elections in Florida and Ohio. When is the best time to run for a Senate seat? Honestly, it depends a bit on the specific seat. One way to decide when to run for Senate is by first identifying the Senators for your state and then looking at what year they were elected. Sometimes, however, Senators are appointed. For example, Alex Padilla is a candidate in the senate races for 2022, but he was appointed in January 2020 after Kamala Harris vacated the seat to run as Vice President alongside Joe Biden. Not sure where to look to find the information? Check with websites like Ballotpedia, which offer detailed elections calendars . Who are the current Senators for my state? You can’t build a campaign strategy without knowing who currently holds the office you want to run for . That information is essential with federal elections as federal-level elections require very large budgets (which we’ll discuss later). Luckily, this information is easy to find. The U.S. Senate website has a list of U.S. senators you can search through. An interactive state map even lets you search by state. Clicking on your state in the map gives you a headshot of your state’s current Senators and their contact information. Once you identify your Senators, you’ll want to know the budget for their last election and the margins they won by. This information will ultimately help you determine your Senate campaign’s budget. Having an idea of the budget you’ll need will also help you develop strategies for fundraising, advertising, and GOTV efforts. We’ll cover more about how to find this information in a later section of this guide. First, let’s look at setting up the foundations of your brand as a political candidate. Why should you run for Senate? This question isn’t meant to send you down a path of self-reflection. Rather, answering the question will help you build your messaging and leadership qualities as a politician. It’s an important question to ask anyone considering public service. Of course, before you start building your political brand, you’ll need to meet a few constitutional requirements before considering running for a Senate seat. Do I qualify? To qualify to serve in the U.S. Senate , you must meet three main conditions: You must meet the age requirement for the Senate: 30 years old. You must have been a U.S. citizen for at least nine years. You must reside in the state you’ll represent as a Senator. You’ll also need to be mindful of other senate qualifications. For example, the FEC (which governs campaign finance laws) states that candidates must raise and/or spend a total of $5,000 to qualify as a candidate . Before you can raise funds and register as a candidate to be on the ballot for senate, however, you’ll first need to form a political committee. What is my experience, political and otherwise? First, you don’t need political experience to run for Senate. The first political campaign for many elected Senators was for the Senate race they ultimately won. Senators Mark Kelly and Ralph Warnock are great examples. Before becoming a senator, Ralph Warnock was a pastor, while Mark Kelly was an astronaut. In other words, No political experience? No problem. Use your career and life experience to show voters and/or donors that you have the following traits: Consensus-building ability: Show that your campaign brings people together. From the earliest stages of fundraising , the strength and credibility of your campaign are demonstrated by how well you unite people around your cause. Each contribution represents a person/people who believes in you as a candidate. Confident stature: Do you have the leadership qualities to make connections and work toward a common goal? Can you assert yourself when necessary and resolve conflicts in ways that build relationships? Such leadership qualities will help you negotiate with your colleagues, which will be vital to delivering on your campaign promises. Persuasiveness: Convincing voters and donors to support you during your campaign is just the beginning. As a politician, you’ll have a lot of conflicting interests to balance, especially on the federal level. You must, therefore, be able to engage audiences and influence them to lean toward your vision and build a media presence. The same applies to your ability to impact the legislative process or media relations. Gaining such experience can happen in several ways. And really, a combination of forces is involved. Senator Warnock’s career easily involves many skills he needs to be a good senator. On the other hand, being an astronaut is an accomplishment, but it doesn’t obviously translate to skills that will be helpful in a Senator role. Instead, Senator Kelly’s policy analysis and political presence have his advocacy and grassroots organizing for gun law reform . What do I offer the seat? Your professional experience isn’t as important to most voters as what you can offer the Senate seat you’re running for. Even more important is developing a clear, compelling message for voters and media relations—showing you can give voters what they want and establish the media presence needed to compete. An issues page on your website is very helpful to that goal. Having a clear presentation of the issues that will inform your policy analysis, committee work, and decision-making is critical to telling voters your story and why you’re running for public office. At the same time, you can’t just throw up a bunch of text with a laundry list of what’s generally important to you. You need messaging that conveys you have a plan for what to do with the office. You also want to answer some important questions in voters’ minds: What would you do differently than the incumbent or opponents? What are your philosophy and lived experience? How will those elements translate into your work as a Senator? How much does it cost to run for Senate? A run for Senate can be pretty costly, and the cost is only getting more expensive each election cycle, especially for Democrats. In 2020, Democratic Senate candidates spent $280 million more than Republican candidates, largely propelled by grassroots organizing and fundraising. Remember when looking at prior candidates’ budgets came up a bit earlier? Understanding the budget of past elections will help you get an idea of what type of budget you’ll need, ultimately informing you of how much money you’ll need to raise for your Senate race. Where should you look? The FEC has detailed spreadsheets with financial data from congressional candidates during the 2020 election cycle . There, you’ll find financial information for both the House and Senate candidates, broken down by receipts, disbursements, cash on hand, debts owed, and more. Once you have these totals, you can start piecing your budget together based on staff, operational, and other costs (e.g., advertising, polling, fundraising events, etc.). To give you some real-life context, below is a chart that shows you how much money was raised by each of the top 5 Democratic candidates for Senate in 2020. All but Amy McGrath earned more than $100 million over two years leading up to the 2020 Senate elections. That’s a lot of money! The examples above outpace most of the 2020 primary presidential candidates . In general, though, challenger Democrats collected fewer funds from PACs than Republican candidates. McGrath, for example, brought in $353,988 in PAC-related funding, while Mitch McConnell brought in $3.6 million from PACs. Of the 10 candidates that accepted the most from PACs in 2020, only one was a Democrat. This trend is particularly pronounced with challengers (versus incumbents) who are not yet a proven commodity and cannot rely on a large amount of PAC or institutional money. Why does all this information matter? It highlights the importance of individual and grassroots fundraising in modern politics . Some differences in where funds come from will be related to the FEC’s campaign contribution limits for federal elections . However, there has also been a shift in many Democratic campaigns—away from corporate money and interests and toward grassroots contributions. What kind of campaign staff do I need? There’s no set list of staff you need, given that campaign staff can vary quite a bit for U.S. Senate campaigns. Below, though, you’ll see a few key roles you’ll want to fill: Finance director: The finance director should typically be the first hire for your political campaign because they manage the fundraising. This role also includes conducting donor research, setting up a finance plan, organizing fundraising events and candidate call time, and following up with potential donors. Campaign manager: A campaign manager will manage and coordinate all staff and consultants on your campaign. The campaign manager will also help make decisions, handle day-to-day tasks, and keep the campaign (and you, the candidate) well-organized. Field directors: Field directors manage voter outreach for your campaign. They oversee volunteers who participate in canvassing, phone banking, Get Out the Vote efforts., and grassroots organizing. Treasurer : A treasurer can help your campaign comply with political campaign finance laws . This position is usually a part-time one for U.S. Senate races. That being said, you won’t need a full campaign staff immediately. The staff required to run in a primary election is much smaller than what you’ll need for the general election. For example, you won’t need field directors until 6-9 months before the election. Top-tier senate campaigns often see a staff between 20-50 people for the general election. For additional information on what staff positions you might want to fill (and when), see our blog on political campaign staff . Your campaign budget will help you understand what kind of staff you can afford. But generally, staffing costs shouldn’t exceed 10% of your overall budget. How do I set up my political campaign? Now that you understand the scale and scope of campaigning for Senate, it’s time to discuss the process of setting up your campaign. First up are the administrative aspects of establishing your campaign. Admin Tasks Many administrative tasks must be tackled to make your campaign an official organization and to roll out your campaign’s branding. Here’s a list of the most essential admin tasks: Register as a political committee so that you can fundraise. Get an EIN number from the IRS. Set up a bank account for your political campaign. Register to be on the ballot. Collect donor lists and find a fundraising CRM like ActBlue or Numero . Set up your website, social media accounts, etc. Most of the list is geared toward getting you ready to accept political contributions. However, there’s one more vital step before you can start fundraising. Donor Research Before you can start fundraising, you need a solid list of potential contributors. You can start with all of your family, friends, and acquaintances (both old and new). Look for basic information about them: Who are they? What do they do for a living? How much have they given, and to whom? What connections might you share with them? (i.e., shared home towns, alma maters, acquaintances, etc.) Finding this information allows you to forge a connection with them early into your introductions, making them more likely to contribute to your campaign. Building a rapport with people helps! Fundraising Fundraising is the only way you’ll run a successful campaign. And having a solid fundraising plan in place—before you start campaigning—is crucial to your success. It’s best to start fundraising with your own network of family, friends, and acquaintances , but you’ll also need to forge new connections. This step is where having a strong message and interesting fundraising ideas can help. The bottom line is that you’ll need to find ways to broaden your social circles and convince strangers to support your candidacy. Feeling overwhelmed? It’s okay! Plenty of professionals are out there who can serve as consultants to help you manage your campaign. Consultants Political consultants are professionals who work with multiple campaigns to help advise and/or run the campaign. Consultants are paid positions, but the consultants themselves can work with a firm or be freelancers. Some consultants offer general campaign management experience, and some specialize in specific areas of the campaign. Whatever the case, consultants can help you with any number of areas. Here are just a few examples: Completing admin tasks Organizing fundraisers Maintaining financial compliance Conducting donor research Creating/placing TV spots and/or sending mailers Managing social media How do I gain support for my campaign? There are four key ways to gain support for your senate campaign: Fundraising : Your earliest efforts will focus heavily on reaching out to every contact you have and encouraging them to reach out to their contacts. Fundraising often starts well before your name is on the ballot and continues until Election Day. Endorsements : Gaining public seals of approval from high-profile individuals or businesses will boost your campaign’s visibility. Celebrity endorsements help, but endorsements from other politicians, local businesses, community leaders, and so on can also be quite helpful to your campaign. Canvassing : Grassroots organizing and talking to people face-to-face helps your campaign reach more potential voters. The benefit is two-fold: you get a prime opportunity to receive feedback on your campaign and encourage more action from voters. Direct interaction with voters creates a more personal connection between them and your campaign (and helps the important GOTV efforts right before Election Day—as you’ll learn below). When running for Senate, you must have a strong field team to help canvass voters across your state. ‍ GOTV : Get-out-the-vote efforts don’t start until right before the election (usually 4–21 days ahead of time). These efforts are geared toward encouraging voter participation. At this stage, it’s less about changing minds and more about encouraging action. GOTV efforts can take the form of canvassing, phone banking, or running TV, radio, or social media ads. What happens after the election? If you win, you’ll need to prepare for your first day on the job as a senator. And win or lose, you’ll need to be prepared to decide what to do with leftover campaign funds. (We’ll address what to do if you lose, too, because—as you’ll learn—losing doesn’t mean the end of your not-yet-started political career.) Handling leftover campaign funds It’s possible that once the campaign ends, some funds will remain in your campaign bank account. You can do many things with these funds: Use them to pay off the remaining debts from the campaign. Donate them to other campaigns or PACs within your party Keep them and transfer them to your next political campaign. Turning losses into wins Ideally, your run for senate will be successful, and you’ll transition from campaigning to working as a Senator. But should you lose, don’t be discouraged! Losing has always been a major part of the campaigning process. Even seasoned politicians lose campaigns from time to time. Joe Biden, for example, ran for president three times before winning his 2020 presidential campaign. Bernie Sanders has also lost many elections , including two senate elections, three gubernatorial, four house, and two presidential primary elections. In 2000, he lost the Democratic primary for a seat in the House of Representatives and then won the general election by running as an independent. He repeated this same pattern in 2004 by running as a progressive. Despite losing elections for these specific offices, he has served in the House and Senate for a combined 30+ years and was the mayor of Burlington, Vermont, for six years. Off to the Senate Races You’ve certainly got a lot of information to process, but we think it’ll give you a lot of momentum as you establish your Senate campaign. (NASDAQ: GOCO), a leading health insurance marketplace and Medicare-focused digital health company, recognizes the service and sacrifices of veterans. The health insurance marketplace also announced that it is on pace to help 25,000 veterans find a health plan this Annual Enrollment Period (AEP), in a year that has seen unprecedented disruption. One of those individuals is Paul Docka, an Air Force veteran from Bluffton, South Carolina, who was impacted by this year’s plan changes. As AEP got underway, Docka, who served for 26 years, and his wife Mary, made a call to GoHealth licensed insurance agent Dalynn Garfield, who informed the Dockas that their previous Medicare plan would no longer offer dental coverage. Concerned about this loss of benefits, Paul and Mary talked through their options with Garfield to find a plan that better aligned with their personal and financial needs. “It feels good to know that somebody else is looking out for me,” Paul said. “And that’s what a veteran needs, another set of eyes that he can trust to work out what he needs with life.” In a conversation with Garfield, Mary said, “We feel very confident that you stay on top of what each different policy can offer and what fits for us. You know what type of things we use, what type of things we need, and you watch out for which is the best for us.” GoHealth CEO Vijay Kotte said helping veterans access the best possible Medicare plan is part of the company’s core mission. “At GoHealth, our goal is to ensure that every beneficiary has the right Medicare coverage for their needs. For us, Veterans Day is a reminder of the deep gratitude we owe to our nation’s heroes,” Kotte said. “It’s an honor to help veterans who served our country, and now rely on us to serve them by finding suitable and affordable healthcare options.” Paul is one example of the unprecedented disruption that Medicare beneficiaries are experiencing this AEP. In an analysis of more than 5,000 Medicare Advantage plans from top health insurers, GoHealth found that an estimated 6 million Medicare Advantage beneficiaries are expected to face plan degradation, an erosion of benefits offered within their specific plan. Furthermore, according to Deft Research , an estimated 2 million are expected to be affected by plan exits, which means carriers will no longer be offering that plan within a specific county. With several Medicare Advantage plan changes this AEP, Kotte encourages beneficiaries to explore all options to understand the different types of plan options available. “Medicare Advantage beneficiaries are staring down a truly unprecedented enrollment period,” Kotte said. “Now more than ever, it is imperative that consumers shop around and compare plans to ensure they find a plan that best fits their personal needs.” For more information, visit www.GoHealth.com . This year’s AEP ends December 7. About GoHealth Inc. As a leading health insurance marketplace, GoHealth believes every Medicare consumer should have personalized guidance so they can find a plan that fits their needs and budget. For customers, enrolling in a health insurance plan is confusing and difficult, and seemingly small differences between plans can lead to significant out-of-pocket costs or lack of access to critical medicines and even providers. GoHealth uses their technology, agents, and expertise to cut through the confusion and get customers enrolled in a plan with the right coverage and benefits. title: The Impact of Supply Chain Disruptions on Healthcare Providers
body_text: by Kolade Adebiyi On my way to work this morning, I found myself eavesdropping on two mothers chatting in the back of the bus. Their voices carried the frustration so many people feel these days. One mother was lamenting how difficult it had become to find Silverbird oil (eucalyptus oil) for her baby, while the other added that even when she did manage to find it, the quality wasn’t as effective as it used to be. Listening to their conversation, I immediately empathized, both as a regular consumer and as a supply chain analyst. This wasn’t just an isolated incident. It’s a story I have heard repeatedly, a story that reflects a much bigger issue. Eucalyptus oil, known as Silverbird oil in Nigeria, is a household remedy many of us grew up with. Whether it’s a cold, cough, or the flu, this oil has been a go-to for generations. It’s a staple for families trying to soothe their kids’ respiratory troubles or looking for quick relief from common ailments. But lately, it’s been disappearing from store shelves. Produced by Bell, Sons & Co. in the UK, this once abundant remedy has become increasingly scarce, leaving both healthcare providers and everyday people in a difficult position. The scarcity stems from various disruptions in the global supply chain. In the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, industries worldwide experienced severe delays (Springer), and the production of essential items like Silverbird oil was hit hard. Factories were short on raw materials, and workers were either laid off or unable to return to their jobs, causing a ripple effect that still lingers today. As a result, fewer shipments of pharmaceutical products and other imported goods made their way to countries like Nigeria. Even as manufacturers slowly ramped up production again, the challenges didn’t stop there. The cost of shipping skyrocketed, and Nigerian ports, notorious for their congestion, added further delays. Importers struggled to get goods cleared, meaning products like Silverbird oil and other pharmaceuticals spent more time stuck at the docks than in the hands of people who desperately needed them. Compounding the issue is the complexity of Nigeria’s regulatory landscape. The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) is responsible for ensuring that all imported products meet safety and quality standards, which is essential for public health. However, the sheer volume of imports and the sometimes cumbersome inspection process can mean that it takes much longer to get goods into the market. The intention is good for consumer protection but it sometimes inadvertently contributes to longer lead times for essential products. Another factor hitting close to home is the economic situation in Nigeria. The devaluation of the naira has made imports far more expensive than they used to be (Punch NG). A product that once felt affordable is now out of reach for many. Pharmaceutical companies, dealing with rising costs, are importing fewer bottles of eucalyptus oil and other medications. Fewer bottles mean higher prices and higher prices mean families like those mothers on the bus are struggling to find or afford a remedy they have relied on for years. The consequences of this scarcity are widespread. Healthcare providers, who have long recommended Silverbird oil for its natural healing properties, are now turning to alternatives. But these alternatives often come with their own set of challenges ranging from prices, unfamiliarity, or ineffectiveness. And then there’s the issue of counterfeits. Whenever there’s high demand and low supply, you can bet that counterfeiters will step in. Many people, desperate for relief, end up buying fake or substandard products from the open market, which could do more harm than good. This isn’t just an inconvenience, it’s a real threat to health and safety. What’s the way out of this? It’s not an easy fix, but some steps can help. One solution is encouraging local production. If Nigeria can start manufacturing its essential oils, it would reduce our reliance on imports, making products like eucalyptus oil more available and more affordable. At the same time, speeding up import processes and improving port efficiency could help reduce some of the current bottlenecks, getting products to people faster. Another key step is building resilience in the supply chain . By sourcing products from multiple regions and working with diverse suppliers, companies can avoid being overly dependent on one country or one supply line. This way, even when disruptions happen, they’re better prepared to maintain a steady flow of goods into the country. Listening to those mothers on the bus was a powerful reminder of how these larger global issues directly impact our everyday lives. The shortage of Silverbird oil is just one example of how fragile supply chains can disrupt access to basic healthcare products. Thankfully, Remedial Health is at the forefront of building a stronger, more resilient healthcare supply chain. By addressing these challenges head-on; both at a local and global level, we can help ensure that essential products remain available, affordable, and effective for everyone. After all, healthcare isn’t just about treatment; it’s about trust, and when supply chains break down, that trust is shaken. We owe it to ourselves and our communities to build a stronger, more resilient system. For more info or to partner with us at Remedial Health, visit www.remedial.health . Together, we can safeguard access to quality healthcare products for all Nigerians.

title: Event Management Software vs. Manual Event Planning: A Comparative Analysis | Zuddl Blog
summary: Explore the key differences between manual event planning and event management software. Learn how automation, accuracy, scalability, and data management make software the smarter choice for modern event planners.
body_text: Event planning is a highly complex and detail-oriented process, traditionally managed through manual methods such as spreadsheets, phone calls, and emails. This approach was the norm for organizing everything from small corporate gatherings to large-scale conferences for many years. However, as the events industry evolved—particularly with the rise of virtual and hybrid events—manual methods have struggled to keep pace. Enter event management software , a modern solution to automate, streamline, and optimize the event planning process. In this post, we’ll dive into a comparative analysis of manual event planning versus event management software , highlighting the key areas where software is a game-changer for B2B event marketers. The Traditional Approach: Manual Event Planning Manual event planning involves juggling various tasks through different tools—spreadsheets for budgeting, emails for communication, and physical checklists for task management. While this method may work for small events, it quickly becomes overwhelming as event complexity and attendee numbers increase. Key challenges include: Time-Consuming Tasks: Every task requires hours, from tracking registrations to manually updating spreadsheets. Risk of Human Error: Manually entering data opens the door to mistakes, miscommunication, and missed deadlines. Limited Scalability: As your event grows, so do the inefficiencies of manual processes, making it difficult to scale. Fortunately, the rise of event management software offers a more efficient and scalable alternative. Comparative Analysis 1. Efficiency and Time Management Manual Planning: Traditional event planning is a time sink. From managing attendee registrations to coordinating vendor logistics, every detail must be manually tracked, updated, and communicated. Event planners often spend hours reconciling spreadsheets, sending follow-up emails, and updating schedules. This labor-intensive process limits planners' ability to focus on higher-level strategy or creativity. Event Management Software: In contrast, event management software automates many of the most time-consuming tasks . Registration systems can automatically track attendee sign-ups, send out confirmations, and even process payments. Tools like automated scheduling and vendor management systems reduce the need for back-and-forth communication. According to a study, event planners using software reports save up to 30% of their time, which can be reinvested into more strategic activities. Verdict: Software offers significant time savings by automating repetitive tasks, allowing planners to focus on big-picture elements like content development and attendee engagement. 2. Accuracy and Error Reduction Manual Planning: Human error is an unavoidable risk in manual planning. Whether it’s a typo in an email or an incorrect data entry in a spreadsheet, small mistakes can snowball into major issues, such as incorrect attendee information, double bookings, or even budget overruns. The risk grows as event complexity increases, especially with large-scale conferences or hybrid events. Event Management Software: Event management software minimizes these risks by automating data entry, registration, and communication. Once attendee information is entered into the system, it’s tracked and stored without repetitive manual input. For example, when using a software solution, an attendee’s registration information is automatically synced with other event details like ticketing and session preferences, reducing the potential for errors. Verdict: Event management software greatly reduces the risk of human error, ensuring smoother, more accurate event execution. 3. Scalability Manual Planning: One of the biggest challenges of manual event planning is scalability. While planning a small event might be manageable, scaling up to larger or more complex events presents significant challenges. More attendees mean more data to manage, more vendors to coordinate, and more tasks to track. The limitations of manual methods quickly become apparent as planners struggle to keep up with the growing workload. Event Management Software: Event management software is designed with scalability in mind. Whether planning a small workshop or a multi-day conference with thousands of attendees, software can quickly scale to meet your needs. Features like automated registration, personalized attendee journeys, and centralized communication tools make it easy to manage large events without exponentially increasing your workload. Platforms can also handle in-person and virtual components, making coordinating hybrid events easier. Verdict: Software provides the flexibility and scalability required for larger and more complex events, making it far more effective than manual planning. 4. Data Management Manual Planning: Tracking and managing data manually—whether through spreadsheets, physical documents, or fragmented digital tools—presents significant challenges. Not only is it time-consuming, but it’s also difficult to ensure that all data is up-to-date and accurate. Handling attendee information, budgets, schedules, and feedback across multiple tools can lead to inconsistencies, duplications, or lost information. Event Management Software: Event management software consolidates all your event data into a centralized platform. Everything is stored in one place, from attendee registration data to post-event feedback, making it easy to track, analyze, and act on information in real-time. Additionally, event management platforms offer powerful analytics tools that can provide valuable insights into attendee behavior, session engagement, and more. Verdict: Software makes data management more accessible and far more insightful, giving planners the tools to track engagement and make data-driven decisions. 5. Cost Comparison Manual Planning: At first glance, manual event planning might seem more affordable, as there’s no upfront investment in technology. However, when you factor in the time spent on administrative tasks, the potential for costly errors, and the limited scalability, the long-term inefficiencies of manual planning can outweigh the initial savings. Event Management Software: While there is an initial investment in event management software, it’s essential to consider the long-term cost savings and efficiency gains . The time saved through automation, the ability to scale without exponentially increasing labor costs, and the reduced risk of costly errors all contribute to a more cost-effective solution in the long run. Additionally, many event management platforms offer tiered pricing based on the size and scope of your events, making it a flexible option for various budgets. Verdict: While software requires an upfront investment, the long-term cost savings, scalability, and efficiency gains make it a more economical choice for most event planners. ‍ TL;DR Summary The advantages of modern software solutions are apparent when comparing manual event planning to event management software . It saves time, reduces human error, and provides the scalability, data management, and cost efficiency that today’s B2B event marketers require. While manual planning may work for small events, the complexities of larger, hybrid, or virtual events are best managed through software. With the right platform in place, you’ll be able to plan, execute, and analyze events more efficiently, all while providing a better experience for your attendees. If you’re still relying on manual methods, now might be the time to consider transitioning to an event management software solution. Ready to streamline your event planning process? Yüklerin bir ülke sınırlarından geçerek başka bir ülkeye gönderilmesi sürecini kapsar. Bu süreç, transfer edilen yüklerin transit ülkede herhangi bir vergi ödenmeden taşınmasını sağlar. Ticaretin hızlanmasını, maliyetlerin azaltılmasını sağlayan bu sistem, uluslararası lojistik sektöründe öne çıkan kavramlar arasında yer alır. Türkiye hem Asya hem de Avrupa arasındaki stratejik konumu nedeniyle transit rejimi uygulamalarında önemli bir merkezdir. Ülkemiz uluslararası ticaretin başarılı olması için stratejik bir konumda yer alır. Bu içeriğimizde; transit rejiminin ne olduğu, Türkiye’deki işleyişi, ticaret süreçlerindeki etkisi ve karşılaşılan zorluklar hakkında size detaylı bilgiler sunacağız. Gelin, transit rejimini birlikte değerlendirelim. İçindekiler Toggle Transit Rejimi Nedir? Transit rejimi, yüklerin bir ülkenin topraklarından geçerken bu ülkeye vergi ödemeden geçiş yapması anlamına gelir. Burada transfer edilen ürünler hedef ülkeye götürülürken bazı ülkelerden sadece geçiş yapar. Bu geçiş yapılan ülkeler hedef pazar değildir. Bu rejim sayesinde malların ihracat yapılan ülkeye ulaştırılmasında gümrük işlemleri kolaylaşır. Transit rejim nedir sorusunun cevabı; yüklerin hedef ülkeye giderken geçtiği ülkelerde herhangi bir vergiye tabi tutulmaması olduğunu söyleyebiliriz. Türkiye’de, transit rejimi Gümrük Kanunu’nun 84. maddesi kapsamında yer alır. Taşımacılık süreci, uluslararası ticarete büyük kolaylıklar getiren gümrük gözetimi altında gerçekleşir​. İlgili kanun gereğince yapılan kontroller, lojistik sektörü için güvenli ve yasalara uygun bir sistem oluşmasını sağlar. Transit Ticaret Nedir? Transit ticaret, bir ülkenin toprakları üzerinden başka ülkelere yapılan mal sevkiyatını ifade eder. Bu süreçte, transit ülkeler malı kendi pazarlarına dahil etmediği için mallar vergilendirilmez. Türkiye’nin coğrafi konumu, transit ticarette stratejik bir rol oynamasını sağlar. Türkiye, Asya ve Avrupa arasında köprü konumunda olması nedeniyle transit ticaret için kritik bir noktadadır. Asya, Avrupa ve Orta Doğu arasında önemli bir geçiş noktası olan ülkemiz, transit ticaretin büyük bir bölümünü yönetir. Transit ticaretin temel özelliği, malların geçiş yaptığı ülkeyi sadece köprü olarak kullanması ve bu ülkenin iç pazarına herhangi bir şekilde dahil olmamasıdır. Türkiye’de TIR karnesi gibi uluslararası taşıma belgeleri sayesinde kara, hava, deniz ve demiryolu ile malların taşınmasını mümkün hale getirilmiştir. Türkiye’deki Transit Rejim Uygulamaları ve Taşıma Modları Türkiye’de transit rejimi, çeşitli taşımacılık modları ile uygulanmaktadır. Bu modlar arasında karayolu, denizyolu, demiryolu ve havayolu taşımacılığı yer alır. Her biri, transit taşımacılığının etkin bir şekilde gerçekleştirilmesi için farklı düzenlemelere tabi tutulur. Gelin her bir taşıma modunu detaylı şekilde inceleyelim. Karayolu ile Transit Taşımacılık Türkiye, karayolu taşımacılığında güçlü bir altyapıya sahiptir. TIR sistemi, Türkiye’nin transit rejimindeki en yaygın kullanılan sistemlerinden biridir. Bu sistemle Türkiye üzerinden geçen yükler, gümrükten muaf olarak başka ülkelere sevk edilir. Özellikle TIR sistemi, uluslararası ticaretin karayolu üzerinden yapılmasını hızlandırır. TIR karnesi ile yükler, transit ülkelerde vergi ödemeden hedef ülkeye güvenli bir şekilde ulaştırılır. Denizyolu ile Transit Taşımacılık Türkiye’nin Akdeniz ve Karadeniz’e kıyısı olması, denizyolu taşımacılığını önemli bir transit ticaret merkezi haline getirir. Türkiye’nin Akdeniz ve Karadeniz’deki limanları, deniz ticaretinin en önemli uğrak noktalarıdır. Limanlarda gerçekleştirilen işlemler, transit ticareti hızlandırır​. Gümrük süreçlerinin hızlı tamamlanmasını ve malların hedef ülkelere sorunsuz bir şekilde gönderilmesini sağlar. Demiryolu ile Transit Taşımacılık Son yıllarda demiryolu taşımacılığı, transit ticarette önemli bir alternatif haline gelmektedir. Marmaray ve Bakü-Tiflis-Kars demiryolu hattı, demiryolu transit taşımacılığının bir parçasıdır. Yüklerin güvenli şekilde transfer edilmesini sağlayan demiryolu taşıma modu, ağır ve büyük tonajlı yükler için de idealdir. Havayolu ile Transit Taşımacılık Türkiye’nin önemli bir havayolu merkezi olması, özellikle hızlı kargo taşımacılığında transit ticaretin gelişmesine olanak sağlar. Türkiye üzerinden geçen ürünler, hava kargo taşımacılığı ile hızla hedef ülkelere ulaştırılır. İstanbul Havalimanı gibi uluslararası hava kargo merkezleri, Türkiye’nin transit ticaretinde önemli bir rol oynar. Ortak Transit Rejimi Ortak transit rejimi, Avrupa Birliği ülkeleri ile Avrupa Serbest Ticaret Birliği ülkeleri arasında yapılan süreçtir. Gümrük vergilerinin askıya alınması ile uygulanır. Ortak transit rejimi, 1987 yılında imzalanan Ortak Transit Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde işlenir. Türkiye gibi AB üyesi olmayan ancak transit geçişler için bu sistemi kullanan ülkeler tarafından da sözleşme şartları uygulanır. Ortak transit rejimi, taşımacılık süreçlerini kolaylaştırmak ve hızlandırmak amacıyla Yeni Bilgisayarlı Transit Sistemi (NCTS) üzerinden dijital olarak yürütülür. Teminat uygulamasıyla, yüklerin transfer süreci güvence altına alınır. Rejim, Türkiye’nin 2012’de sisteme dahil olmasıyla kullanılmaya başlanmıştır. Sistemin avantajlarını; işlemlerin hızlandırılması, gümrük vergilerinin askıya alınması ve dijital platformda kolay takip edilebilmesi olarak sıralayabiliriz. Ulusal Transit Rejimi Ulusal transit rejimi, bir ülke sınırları içinde gerçekleştirilen transit taşımacılık işlemlerini kapsar. Türkiye’de 4458 sayılı Gümrük Kanunu çerçevesinde yürütülür. Yüklerin, gümrük işlemleri tamamlanmadan ülke içindeki belirli bir noktadan başka bir noktaya taşınmasını sağlar​. Topluluk Transiti Topluluk transiti, Avrupa Birliği içinde üretilen ve ithal edilen ürünlerin, AB üyesi ülkeler arasında taşınmasını sağlayan bir stratejidir. Topluluk transit rejimi, AB gümrük kodlarına dayalıdır. Topluluk dışından gelen malların AB üyesi ülkelerden geçmesi durumunda, T1 belgesi kullanılarak bu yüklerin transit taşımacılığı yapılır. Mallar AB içinde serbest dolaşıma girdikten sonra ise T2 belgesi ile taşınır. Transit Rejimi Kapsamında Kullanılan Belgeler Transit ticarette kullanılan belgeler, gümrük işlemlerinin düzenli bir şekilde yürütülmesi için gereklidir​. Kısaca bu belgeleri tanıyalım; TIR Karnesi: Karayolu taşımacılığında kullanılan bu belge, malların transit ülkelerde gümrük vergisine tabi tutulmadan taşınmasını sağlar. CIM Taşıma Belgesi: Demiryolu taşımacılığında kullanılan belge, taşınan malların detaylarını içerir. Eşya Manifestosu: Denizyolu taşımacılığında kullanılır. Gemide taşınan tüm malların listesini içerir. Transit taşıma kapsamında yasal evrakların ve belgelerin eksiksiz şekilde araçta bulunması gerekir. Transit rejimde köprü görevi gören ülkelerde gümrük noktalarında sorun çıkmaması için belgelerin eksiksiz olması önemlidir. Transit Ticaretin Ekonomik ve Lojistik Etkileri Transit ticaret, sadece ticaretin hızlanmasına değil, aynı zamanda maliyetlerin düşmesine ve rekabet avantajının artmasına da destek olur. Türkiye gibi transit ülkeler, bu süreçten ekonomik anlamda büyük kazanç elde eder. Türkiye’nin transit ticaretteki rolü, ekonomiye önemli katkılar sunmaktadır. Transit taşımacılık; iş gücü, hizmet sektörü ve altyapı yatırımları gibi alanlarda ekonomik büyüme sağlar. Türkiye’nin coğrafi avantajı ve geniş ulaşım ağı, transit taşımacılıkta lojistik hizmetlerin gelişmesine olanak tanır. Özellikle İstanbul ve çevresindeki lojistik merkezler, transit ticaretin etkin bir şekilde yürütülmesinde önemli rol oynar. Transit Taşımacılıkta Karşılaşılan Zorluklar Transit rejiminin etkin bir şekilde yürütülmesi için bazı zorluklarla baş edebilmek gerekir. Bu zorlukları; gümrük kontrolleri, güvenlik riskleri ve altyapı eksiklikleri şeklinde ifade edebiliriz. Gümrük kontrolleri, transit ticarette zaman kaybına neden olan süreçlerdir. Lojistik sektöründe yaşanan dijital gelişmelerin gümrük noktalarına da entegre edilmesi, zaman tasarrufu için önemlidir. Güvenlik riskleri, özellikle kara yolunda taşınan malların çalınması ve zarar görmesi gibi durumları içerir. Taşıma sigortası, uygun dorse seçimi ve güvenilir rota optimizasyonları gibi güvenlik önlemleri yüklerin eksiksiz şekilde varış noktasına ulaştırılmasını sağlar. Türkiye, transit ticarette önemli bir merkez olsa da altyapı eksiklikleri hala bazı bölgelerde sorun teşkil etmektedir. Demiryolu ağlarının yetersizliği, bazı limanların kapasite sınırlamaları gibi sorunlar transit ticareti yavaşlatır. Bu eksikliklerin kısa sürede planlı şekilde tamamlanması, ülkemizin ekonomisi ve uluslararası ticaretin gelişmesi için önemlidir. Transit Rejiminde Uyum Sağlanması Gereken Kurallar Türkiye’de transit rejimi kurallarına uyulması, gümrük işlemlerinin düzgün ilerlemesi için büyük önem taşır. Gümrük Kanunu’na göre transit beyanı verilen malların doğru şekilde bildirilmesi zorunludur. Yanlış beyanlar ciddi cezalarla sonuçlanır. Transit rejimi ihlallerinde, eşyaların belirtilen cinsten farklı çıkması durumunda malların iki katı kadar idari para cezası uygulanır. Taşımacılık sektöründe başarılı olmak isteyen kurumlar, yasalara uygun şekilde hareket etmeli ve düzenlemeleri yakından takip etmelidir. Transit Rejimi ile İlgili Örnekler Türkiye’nin stratejik konumu, Asya ile Avrupa arasındaki ticaret rotalarında önemli bir rol oynamasını sağlar. Örneğin, Çin’den Avrupa’ya yapılan demiryolu taşımacılığı, Türkiye’nin transit rejiminde oynadığı rolü göstermektedir. Sık Sorulan Sorular Transit rejimi nedir ve nasıl işler? Transit rejimi, bir ülkenin topraklarından geçerek başka bir ülkeye gönderilen malların gümrük vergisine tabi tutulmadan taşınmasını sağlayan düzenlemedir. Yükler hedef noktaya varana kadar bazı geçiş yolları kullanır. Bu geçiş yollarında olan ülkelerde bu rejim sayesinde gümrük işlemlerine tabi tutulmaz. Gümrük denetimi altında uygulanan bu rejim, uluslararası ticaretin daha hızlı ve az maliyetli olmasını sağlar. Transit ticaret Türkiye’de nasıl uygulanır? Türkiye’de transit ticaret, 4458 sayılı Gümrük Kanunu çerçevesinde uygulanır. Mallar, gümrük vergisi ödenmeden Türkiye üzerinden geçerek başka bir ülkeye sevk edilir. Karayolu, demiryolu, denizyolu ve havayolu kullanılarak yapılan bu işlem, gümrük denetimi altında yürütülür ve ticareti kolaylaştırır. Transit geçiş ne demek? Transit geçiş, bir ülkenin sınırlarından geçerek başka bir ülkeye gönderilen malların, o ülkede vergilendirilmeden taşınması anlamına gelir. Bu süreçte mallar sadece transit ülkeyi geçer ve gümrük denetimi altında olur. Hedef ülkeye ulaşana kadar ticaret politikası önlemlerine tabi tutulmaz. Transit taşıma nedir? Transit taşıma için hangi belgeler gereklidir? Transit taşıma, bir ülkenin köprü olarak kullanılması ile başka bir ülkeye gönderilen malların, gümrük işlemlerine tabi tutulmadan transfer edilmesidir. TIR Karnesi, CIM Taşıma Belgesi ve Eşya Manifestosu gibi önemli evraklar transit taşımada kullanılır. Transit ticaretin Türkiye ekonomisine etkileri nelerdir? Transit ticaret, Türkiye ekonomisine olumlu katkılar sağlar. Stratejik konumu sayesinde lojistik ve taşımacılık sektörleri gelişir. İstihdamın artması için taşımacılık sektörünün gelişmesi önemlidir. Ayrıca, transit ticaret hizmetleri ve altyapı yatırımları, ülkeye döviz girmesi için etkili bir yöntemdir. Transit yük nedir? Transit yük, bir taşıma aracında geçici olarak bulunan ve nihai varış noktasına ulaşmadan önce başka bir yerden geçen yük anlamına gelir. Gümrük kontrolü ve depolama gibi süreçlerden geçerken geçici olarak tutulur. Transit yük, uluslararası ticarette önemli bir rol oynar. Transit ülke nedir? Bir malın nihai varış noktasına ulaşmadan önce geçiş yaptığı ülke anlamına gelir. Bu tür ülkeler, uluslararası ticarette önemli bir rol oynar. Çünkü yüklerin geçici olarak depolandığı ve gümrük işlemlerinin yapıldığı yerlerdir. title: Understanding One-Time Passcode Fraud
summary: Learn what OTP fraud is and how to protect yourself from online scams using one-time passwords. Stay safe with simple tips and prevention methods.
body_text: One-time password (OTP) scams are a growing threat to businesses and consumers alike. In 2021, US consumers lost a staggering $13.9 billion to fraud, with OTP scams accounting for a significant portion of these losses. This rising trend poses serious financial and reputational risks for businesses. But what exactly is OTP fraud, and how do scammers exploit it? Let’s see. What is OTP fraud? An OTP is sent to individuals by mobile phone or email. It’s used to authenticate transactions, such as logging into accounts or making payments. Fraudsters, however, exploit this security feature through various tactics. These include SIM swapping, phishing emails, fake tech support calls, and social engineering. They design each of these methods to trick individuals into revealing their OTPs. How does OTP fraud work? OTP fraud takes place when an attacker uses the OTP system to gain unauthorized access to someone’s financial accounts or online profiles. Here’s how it works: Targeting victims: Fraudsters often select targets based on their online behavior, weak points in communication methods like SMS or email, or publicly shared information on social media. Launching the attack: They employ phishing techniques to impersonate legitimate organizations, such as banks or e-commerce platforms. They focus on creating a sense of urgency through emails, SMS, or phone calls to trick targets into taking action. Collecting personal information: The phishing messages lead to fake websites that look like trusted ones. Here, targets unknowingly provide personal details like usernames and passwords. Trapping with OTPs: The fake website triggers the OTP and sends it to the target’s phone. Fraudsters then use various methods to steal the OTP, such as: Social engineering: The attacker may try to convince the individual to share the OTP, claiming it is for account verification. Malware Interception: If malware infects the individual’s device, it intercepts and captures the OTP without the user’s knowledge. Taking over the account: With the user credentials and OTP, the fraudster can access the account. This allows them to perform unauthorized transactions, steal data, or take control of future OTPs. Common methods used by scammers OTP phishing attacks take many forms, each targeting different vulnerabilities in users. Below are some common OTP fraud tactics: Smishing Smishing is a term that combines “SMS” and “phishing.” Here, fraudsters use fake text messages to trick individuals into downloading malware or sharing sensitive information, like OTPs. Smishing attacks have become more common. In 2023, 75% of organizations reported facing these types of attacks. Scammers often hide their identity by spoofing phone numbers or sending texts from email accounts. For example, smishing texts often include links or attachments that seem safe but lead to fake websites. These imitation sites look like real financial or service provider portals, where users may unknowingly enter their login credentials and OTPs. This gives scammers access to real accounts. SIM swapping SIM swapping occurs when fraudsters trick a mobile carrier into transferring a victim's phone number. Here’s how it works: Attackers gather personal information like names, addresses, or answers to security questions, often through phishing, data breaches, or dark web purchases. This information is used to impersonate the victim and contact the mobile carrier, claiming that the scammers lost or damaged the SIM card. They then ask the carrier to transfer the victim's phone number to a new SIM. If the carrier fails to verify the request, the fraudster takes control of the number. From there, they intercept calls, texts, and verification codes, allowing them to bypass security and access sensitive accounts. This growing problem has had a significant financial impact. In 2023 alone, SIM swapping fraud caused over $48 million in losses, targeting both individuals and companies So, to protect your business from SIM-swapping attacks, combining the right technology with a proven approach is essential. Using Plivo , you can validate phone numbers smoothly, ensuring fraudsters can’t take advantage of SIM swaps. The Plivo Lookup API helps detect SIM swaps in real time. It offers phone number validation and key analytics to assess risks. Some of the critical data it provides includes: Current and original network details Roaming status and network changes Risk scores and unusual patterns that indicate fraud Businesses can spot suspicious activity and take action before any harm occurs with these insights. SMS pumping SMS pumping, or artificially inflated traffic (AIT), is a cybercrime aimed at businesses that rely on SMS for sending OTPs or app download links. In this type of attack, bots fill out a company’s online forms with fake phone numbers controlled by attackers. Believing these to be real requests, the business sends out SMS messages to these fake numbers. For businesses, SMS pumping increases messaging costs, wastes resources, and can overwhelm systems. Plus, if customers see too many unnecessary OTPs, it may damage their trust in the company. To address this, Plivo has two built-in security layers— Fraud Shield and SMS Pumping Protection —that help protect Verify and Messaging traffic from SMS pumping attacks. Both features use an advanced detection model to identify artificially inflated traffic and block suspicious messages before they’re sent, helping reduce exposure to fraud and unnecessary costs. The Geo Permissions feature also gives you control over where messages are sent by allowing you to enable or disable countries and apply message-per-hour thresholds based on your risk tolerance. Voice phishing (vishing) Vishing, or voice phishing, is a type of scam where fraudsters use phone calls to trick people into sharing sensitive information, like login details, credit card numbers, or bank account info. Scammers exploit this data for identity theft and financial fraud, making vishing widespread and costly. In 2023, over 56 million U.S. adults — about 21% of the population — fell victim to phone scams, resulting in losses totaling $25.4 billion. In vishing scams, attackers often impersonate trusted organizations and use phone calls to create a sense of urgency and trust. They also build a personal connection over the phone, reacting to what the victim says and using emotional cues. How OTP scams impact businesses Here’s how scammers misuse OTPs and why this should be a major concern for businesses: Account takeovers Stealing or tricking users into sharing their OTP allows fraudsters to bypass security, gain control of accounts, and access private information or funds. This can harm trust and cause legal problems for businesses, especially those handling sensitive data or finances. In fact, the average cost of a data breach in 2023 was $4.45 million , underscoring the serious financial impact of such security failures. Unauthorized transactions With OTPs, scammers can authorize fraudulent transactions. If they gain access to a customer’s account, they can make purchases, transfer funds, or exploit stored payment methods. As a result, businesses may face chargebacks, financial losses, and increased scrutiny from payment providers due to such fraudulent activities​. Fake account registration and spamming Some scammers use stolen OTPs to create fake accounts on business platforms, taking advantage of promotional offers or testing one-time passcode security. Fake registrations can distort the numbers, affect data accuracy, and lead to spam, resulting in unnecessary management overload. Spreading malware or phishing attacks If scammers access your business email or social media accounts, they can send phishing messages or malware links to your contacts. Scammers make these messages look authentic, so recipients are more likely to trust and open them. This spreads the scam further and damages your reputation. It also puts your clients, partners, and employees at risk. Practical tips for protecting against OTP fraud To effectively protect your business from OTP fraud, it's important to take a proactive approach. Implementing strong security measures can significantly reduce risks. Here are some practical tips for businesses to safeguard against OTP fraud: Implement 2FA with fraud prevention Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an important layer of security by requiring both a password and an OTP. However, despite its effectiveness, many organizations are still not fully adopting this security measure. In fact, a recent survey found that 64% of organizations haven't fully adopted multi-factor authentication (MFA). This is concerning because research shows that MFA can block over 99.9% of account takeover attacks . Without MFA, businesses are leaving their accounts — and their customers — vulnerable to fraud. Plivo's 2FA/OTP capabilities can help overcome OTP verification vulnerabilities. Adding these extra layers of security prevent account takeovers, reduce fraud risks, and secure high-value transactions. Additionally, Plivo provides several advanced features to further enhance security: Geo permission management: Control which countries your Plivo account can send SMS or make calls to, blocking high-risk areas. International toll fraud protection: Manage connections to premium numbers and set blacklists to prevent toll fraud. Pattern-based alerts: Get notified about unusual SMS or voice activity, like sudden drops in delivery rates, to detect potential fraud early. Given the growing risk of cyberattacks, it’s more important than ever to implement 2FA. By doing so, you can better protect your business and customers from fraud. Monitor and track OTP delivery effectiveness Delays or failed OTP deliveries can frustrate users, damage trust, and open doors for attackers to exploit system weaknesses. With Plivo’s real time delivery reports, businesses can monitor OTP performance globally. This helps track delivery rates and identify potential issues. Businesses can use this data to quickly address problems and ensure they deliver OTPs promptly and securely. Limiting OTP validity and attempt frequency Setting a time limit for OTP validity and limiting the number of attempts helps prevent misuse and reduces fraud risk. Businesses can also lower the chances of attackers guessing or intercepting valid codes. This ensures that only legitimate users can complete the authentication process within the allowed time. Regularly update your security protocols and stay compliant Staying compliant with security standards ensures that businesses are using the latest practices to protect data. This helps guard against new fraud techniques and reduces the risk of breaches. Choose a OTP service provider, such as Plivo, that ensures continuous compliance with security standards. Plivo designs its OTP solutions to adhere to regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). With advanced security features and detailed reporting, Plivo makes it easier for businesses to stay compliant and protect sensitive user data. Choose a secure algorithm Use strong algorithms like HMAC-based one-time passwords (HOTP) or time-based one-time passwords (TOTP). These options are reliable because they generate unique and hard-to-predict OTPs. Their cryptographic methods help protect against common attacks, ensuring secure authentication. Provide multiple delivery options Flexibility is important for OTP delivery. Offering choices like SMS, email, or voice ensures users can receive their OTPs in the way that suits them best. This also improves user experience and offers a backup if one method doesn't work. Educate users on security best practices Teaching users about security best practices for OTPs reduces the risk of fraud and strengthens overall protection. Encourage users to create strong, unique passwords, avoid sharing OTPs, and recognize phishing attempts. Regularly remind them about the importance of safeguarding their accounts and following secure authentication processes to prevent unauthorized access. Prevent OTP fraud with the help of Plivo today When selecting an OTP provider, it's important to choose one that offers both robust security and user-friendly features. Plivo provides a secure and adaptable OTP solution, designed to fit your unique needs. Plivo’s OTP services simplify the authentication process, offering global SMS delivery, instant reporting, and customizable templates for easy implementation. Whether it's safeguarding transactions, verifying users, or securing sensitive information, Plivo’s OTP services offer the reliability and flexibility necessary for your security needs. title: How to Sell on TikTok in 2024: Best Practices for Amazon Sellers
summary: Whether you are already posting TikTok videos or have never even tried, this guide will help you get the most out of your video marketing efforts.
body_text: TikTok has become a dominant social media force, but it's more than dance crazes and viral trends. It has also become a powerful sales tool for FBA sellers. With over a billion active users, TikTok lets you reach an engaged audience and drive serious sales. Whether you are already posting TikTok videos or have never even tried, this guide will help you get the most out of your video marketing efforts. Read on to learn what every FBA seller needs to know about TikTok as a sales tool. Creating an FBA seller TikTok Profile As an FBA seller, your TikTok profile is like your storefront for that platform. Don't be tempted to jump into posting product videos without creating a bio that connects with your target audience. Set up a Pro Account A Pro Account is free, but it still gives you access to valuable insights about your audience and content performance. As every FBA seller knows, the best strategies start with strong data, which is how you get that data on TikTok. Craft a Compelling Bio Your bio is your first impression. Keep it concise, informative, and engaging, but make sure you include important content and information such as: A clear brand identity means not just your brand name but also what you offer and the categories of items you sell. (e.g., "Eco-friendly kitchen gadgets") Your Amazon store should be center stage and linked to from your bio, along with a few details about what you sell that entice them to click. Relevant keywords that you used to draw in customers on Amazon can help potential customers find you TikTok as well. A call to action in your bio will encourage users to visit your Amazon store. Remember to update your CTA for seasonal sales and special promotions. Choose the Right Visuals Your profile picture should include a high-quality image of your logo or a representative product for your brand. A cover video takes your profile to another level and is a great way to showcase your products or brand personality. Example Bio: ✨ Sustainable kitchenware for a healthier planet ✨ Shop our eco-friendly products on Amazon! ➡️ [Link to your Amazon Store] #ecofriendly #kitchen #sustainableliving Content Strategies for FBA Sellers Your TikTok needs a content strategy that excites your audience and gets them to click over to your Amazon storefront. A few examples of sure-fire content that sells include: Product demos show your products in action and highlight key features and benefits. It's important to be informative, but don't forget that TikTok is about entertainment. You can even try a bit of humor, but remember to keep it professional. "Did You Know?" videos educate your audience while highlighting your products. The video can talk about an unusual product feature, or it can address a common problem and set up your product as the perfect solution. Customer review spotlights use positive reviews from your Amazon listings to build trust and social proof. You can even duet with a review video from to showcase what others think of your products. Behind-the-scenes content can give your audience a feeling of connection and is a great way to draw attention to sustainability practices or your dedication to selling quality-manufactured products. Videos may give a look at how your products are made or how you choose the best products for your store. Relevant trends that pop up on TikTok can really boost your signal if you jump on at the right time. Keep an eye on trending topics each day for opportunities to draw more views to your existing videos. Relevant keywords in your TikTok captions and hashtags will help to attract the right audience. Example If you sell a unique kitchen gadget, you could create a dynamic video set to a trending song with a demonstration of the gadget in use and a text overlay that highlights key features. Don't forget a clear call to action such as, "Shop now - link in bio!" Engage the TikTok Community TikTok is a social platform, not a one-way sales channel. That means building relationships with potential customers, but don't worry, this doesn't have to be another full-time job. Some examples of ways to keep things social on Tik Tok include: Be responsive to comments and questions. The TikTok algorithm prioritizes accounts with high engagement, and responsiveness also shows your audience you value their interactions, helping you to build a loyal following. Participate in relevant trends and challenges to increase your visibility and reach a wider audience. Find your people by collaborating with creators in complementary niches. Cross-promotion exposes your brand to a new audience and adds variety to your content. Go live with your product demonstrations or host Q&As. You can encourage engagement by offering exclusive deals or bundles, and you can also use live videos to premiere new products. title: Executing Dynamic JavaScript Code on Supabase with Edge Functions
summary: Learn how to execute dynamic JavaScript code on Supabase using Edge Functions.
body_text: We're always looking for ways to improve the developer experience and reduce complexity across your application development pipeline. One way you can use Supabase to do that is with dynamic JavaScript in Edge Functions. This greatly increases the versatility of your edge functions and reduces the need for you to redeploy your functions if you need to change business logic. Introduction to Edge Functions # Edge Functions in Supabase are serverless functions that execute in response to HTTP requests. These functions are deployed at the edge, meaning they run close to the user's location, resulting in faster response times. Why Use Dynamic Code Execution? # Dynamic code execution allows you to modify and run JavaScript code on the fly without having to redeploy your function each time the code changes. This is particularly useful when you need the flexibility to execute different logic depending on the incoming request, without incurring the overhead of redeployment. summary: The Foundation has officially been launched and is accepting scholarship applications and financial donations.
body_text: News The Todd Ramsey Memorial Scholarship Foundation Launches to Honor Legacy 11/21/2024 Phoenix, AZ, November 21, 2024 – The Todd Ramsey Memorial Scholarship Foundation, founded by Judy Ramsey and Bill Jackson, has officially been launched and is accepting scholarship applications and financial donations. This pioneering initiative honors Todd’s career and values by providing students interested in car audio, security and integration with a pathway to technical and business education. The first of the $1,000 and $2,000 biannual scholarships will be awarded in March of 2025. Recipients can use scholarship awards to attend industry training events and formal training schools, receive MECP certification training and exams, and even to buy the necessary tools of the trade. High School seniors, recent graduates, GED holders and new entrants to the industry are all invited to apply. “Our ultimate goal is to deliver a whole new inspired generation of qualified technicians, passionate sales staff, and competent shop operators to the industry”, said Judy Ramsey, Todd’s widow and Co-Founder of the 501(c)(3) organization. Serving as Co-Founder alongside Judy is the former President and CEO of Rockford Corp., Bill Jackson, who is now Sr. Operations Business Advisor to Rockford’s parent organization, Patrick Industries, Inc. (PATK). Bill commented, “To my knowledge, there has never been a program like this for the car audio industry, and I couldn’t be more pleased to help lead the effort. The impact we make with this scholarship foundation will serve the industry for many decades to come.” About The Todd Ramsey Memorial Scholarship Foundation: Todd Ramsey was a renowned 12-volt industry consultant, having started a car stereo shop at the age of 18 in southern California. His deep understanding of automotive electronics led him to design audio and electrical systems from the ground up for cars, motorcycles, UTVs and marine applications. He later took his technical prowess to Europe to train other technicians and advance the car audio industry in England and Turkey. Todd’s encyclopedic knowledge of cars and automotive technology later took him to Arizona, where he was a trade school instructor, and consultant with CEA, MECP, SEMA, SkillsUSA, and served for a time as editor of Mobile Electronics Magazine. Todd’s generosity of time and resources combined with his unrelenting quest for knowledge is reflected in the goal of this scholarship foundation: to make training affordable and accessible to young enthusiasts. For more information about The Todd Ramsey Memorial Scholarship Foundation and its initiatives, please visit www.toddramseyscholarship.com or email [email protected] .

Just a few symbols like asterisks for bold or hashes for headings, and you're off to the races. It's the go-to for bloggers and devs alike, perfect for whipping up websites, blogs, docs, and more. This article itself is written in Markdown. Born for the web, Markdown is the darling of platforms like GitHub, Stack Overflow, and Reddit.
